metadata.title: FCDS Program & Faculty Electives Catalog
metadata.description: Comprehensive, verified program electives for all 6 departments and faculty electives from FCDS bylaws and electives-data

electives.description: Theory and applications of convex optimization in data science, machine learning, and signal processing.
Techniques for discrete, integer, and non-linear optimization problems.
Statistical methods for analyzing multidimensional data sets, PCA, factor analysis, and MANOVA.
Bayesian inference, Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC), prior-posterior calculations, and Bayesian models.
Lossless and lossy data compression algorithms, entropy coding, Huffman, LZW, and transform coding.
Multi-threaded and lock-free data structures, synchronization primitives, and memory models.
Architecture, query optimization, concurrency control, and replication in distributed DBMS.
NoSQL, graph databases, column-store engines, indexing, and high-performance transaction processing.
Human Computer Interaction elective course for Business Analytics
Gamification and Games Development elective course for Business Analytics
Emerging technological paradigms, disruptive innovations, and tech adoption in modern enterprises.

electives.description: Geographic Information Systems, spatial data analysis, geospatial clustering, and location intelligence.
Project management methodologies (PMP, Agile/Scrum), resource allocation, risk and cost management.
Digital public services, urban IoT data ecosystems, citizen engagement, and smart infrastructure analytics.
Economic models of digital platforms, network effects, marketplace dynamics, and business transformation.
Industry 4.0, smart factory data analytics, quality control, and predictive maintenance.
Advanced forecasting, regression, decision trees, and customer lifetime value modeling.
Text mining, sentiment analysis, opinion mining, and topic modeling for market intelligence.
Acoustic modeling, feature extraction (MFCCs), hidden Markov models, and deep neural speech synthesis.
Syntax parsing, semantic role labeling, transformer architectures, and generative language models.
TinyML, edge computing, model quantization, pruning, and deploying neural networks to microcontrollers.
Frontier AI research, neuro-symbolic AI, multimodal architectures, and autonomous agent systems.
Advanced IoT architectures, sensor networks, cloud-to-edge pipelines, and industrial IoT protocols.
Knowledge graphs, ontology engineering, reasoning engines, and expert system inference.
Immersion technologies, spatial tracking, 3D graphics pipelines, and AI-driven interactive environments.
Strategic decision making, Nash equilibrium, multi-agent reinforcement learning, and mechanism design.
Interactive narrative, user experience design, tangible interfaces, and multi-sensory computing.
Data-driven journalism, automated newsroom workflows, verification tools, and content analytics.
Digital image formation, high dynamic range (HDR), depth estimation, and neural rendering.
Keyframing, kinematic rigging, motion capture processing, particle physics, and 3D simulation.
Video Game Design and Programming elective course for Media Analytics
Immersive media production, 360 video, spatial audio, and virtual cinematography.
Deepfake detection, image and video tampering analysis, watermarking, and provenance verification.
Physical principles of diagnostic and therapeutic radiation, imaging physics, and dosimetry.
Cell architecture, genetics, genomic sequencing data, and molecular informatics.
Biological effects of ionizing radiation, radioprotection, and oncology informatics.
Mechanisms of disease states and analytical interpretation of clinical laboratory informatics.
Biomolecules, metabolic pathways, and biochemical data analysis in modern health informatics.
Adversarial attacks on machine learning, data poisoning, model inversion, and defense techniques.
Threat hunting, honeypots, automated defense, vulnerability assessment, and red/blue teaming.
Secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC), static/dynamic analysis, buffer overflows, and fuzzing.
Blockchain and Security of Blockchain elective course for Cybersecurity
Cloud architecture security, IAM, serverless security, multi-tenancy isolation, and compliance.
Graph mining, bot detection, misinformation spread analysis, and identity privacy.
IoT firmware security, communication protocol vulnerabilities (Zigbee, MQTT), and hardware attacks.
Mobile OS security architectures, sandboxing, app permissions, and mobile network security.

faculty_electives.description: Software lifecycle models, requirements engineering, architectural design, testing, and agile methodologies.
Methodologies for analyzing business requirements and designing robust information systems.
Advanced algorithmic techniques including greedy, divide-and-conquer, dynamic programming, and complexity analysis.
Concepts and architectures of distributed computing systems, synchronization, RPC, and fault tolerance.
Development of modern mobile applications for smartphones and tablets across Android and iOS platforms.
Full-stack web application development including client-side interactivity, server APIs, and database integration.
Operating system principles, process scheduling, memory management, file systems, and concurrency.
Computer networking models (OSI and TCP/IP), network protocols, routing algorithms, and network security basics.
Basic first aid techniques, emergency response procedures, and life-saving interventions.
Study of modern tourism principles, sustainable travel, hospitality, and economic impact.
Physical fitness fundamentals, active healthy lifestyle promotion, exercise physiology, and wellness.
Principles of micro and macro economics, market dynamics, and computational economic analysis.
Veterinary principles, safe animal handling techniques, pet welfare, and behavioral management.
Human nutrition essentials, dietary planning, metabolic health, and nutritional wellness.
